title: Epistolae Et Decreta
author: Bonifacius I

passages.original: Augustinus, praemisso Bonifacii elogio, necessitatem exponit hoereticorum epistolis respondendi. Tum hoc opus ad illum potissimum, non ut disceret, sed ut examinaret, vel etiam emendaret, direxisse se si- gnificat.
passages.english: Augustine, after a preface in praise of Boniface, sets out the necessity of replying to the letters of the heretics. Then he indicates that he has addressed this work to him above all, not so that he might learn [from it], but so that he might examine, or even correct, [it].
passages.notes: "hoereticorum" is read as "haereticorum" (heretics), and "si- gnificat" as "significat"; both are scanning or spelling variants. The passage appears to be an editorial summary (argumentum) prefacing Augustine's work addressed to Boniface, presumably Contra duas epistolas Pelagianorum.
